caption:
DJ the Rat, our AI-animated DJ Pest Bot, with 3 signs you could have termites.
Mud tubes up walls or piers.
Skirting boards that sound hollow when tapped.
Small see-through wings near windows.
Found a mud tube? Don't break it open. That can make them harder to find. Get it inspected.
Text your suburb and what you're seeing to 0468 170 107 for a written price.
